reviews.text:
Our AC quit during the heat wave. Dispatch gave me a two-hour window and Luis showed up at the start of it. He found a bad capacitor and a clogged condensate line and showed me both before quoting.

The repair was finished on the same visit, and the invoice matched the tablet quote to the dollar.

Our water heater started leaking on a Sunday. Aurora dispatch picked up on the second ring and had a plumber here in three hours, and the replacement was installed Monday morning. The weekend emergency fee was steep but clearly disclosed up front.
Panel upgrade so we could add an EV charger. Priyanka pulled the permit, coordinated the utility shutoff, and labeled every breaker when she finished. Passed city inspection on the first try.

The tech arrived two hours after the window with no text or call. The fix was fine, but I had rearranged my workday around the appointment. For a dispatch company, delay notifications should be automatic.

reply.text:
Juliet, thank you for telling us, and we're sorry. This isn't the experience we want anyone to have with Hearthquell. A manager will reach out this week to make it right.

Hearthquell Home Services

reviews.text: Booked a fall furnace tune-up online in two minutes. Derek replaced the filter, checked the heat exchanger with a camera, and flagged that the flame sensor will probably need replacing next year, with no pressure to do it today.

I was quoted $450 on the phone for a drain clearing. On site the tech found a root intrusion and quoted $3,800 for a pipe liner. A second opinion said a $600 hydro-jet would do it. That cost you my trust.

reviews.text: The smart thermostat install went smoothly, and Tomás set up the schedule on my phone before he left. My only gripe is that his shoe covers came off halfway through and there were dusty footprints in the hallway.
I manage a 12-unit building in Centennial. The South Foothills team did annual backflow tests for every unit in one morning and emailed the certificates the same afternoon.
The maintenance membership is a good deal, but booking my included tune-up took three calls. Once Kayla in dispatch sorted it out, the visit itself was quick and clean.

reviews.text: Our sump pump failed after a big summer storm. The Parker crew had a new pump with battery backup installed before the next round of rain, and they showed us how to test the alarm.
Whole-home surge protector plus two new GFCI outlets in the kitchen. Clear price up front and tidy work. It took a week to get on the schedule, which is the only reason for four stars.
Two techs argued in front of me about whether my AC compressor was failing. It eventually got fixed, but it didn't feel like they had a shared way of diagnosing problems.
